strings.about.title: About AI Mon
strings.about.body:
AI Mon {version}
Created by hanSU (GitHub: han65535)
https://github.com/han65535/ai-mon
C++ / Win32 · Windows 10/11 x64

Shows account allowance and local token usage.
Claude Code queries allowance using its existing sign-in, without sending a model prompt.

strings.quota.codex_unavailable: This account did not report a main Codex short or weekly limit.
strings.quota.connect_claude: Claude allowance is checked automatically every 2 minutes.
strings.quota.note: Tray: the lower reported remaining %. Left bar: short window; right: weekly. Missing limits stay blank; graphs show recorded values only.
strings.quota.connected: Optional terminal status line connected. Automatic allowance lookup also works with VS Code. Your original status line is preserved; restore it before moving or uninstalling AI Mon.
strings.quota.bridge_changed: Claude settings were changed elsewhere, or another AI Mon bridge exists. Existing settings were preserved; check the status line configuration.
strings.quota.bridge_failed: Could not update Claude settings. Check that Claude Code is installed and its settings folder is writable.
strings.quota.claude_missing: Claude Code not found. Install it and sign in.
strings.quota.claude_failed: Claude lookup failed. Check Claude sign-in and network; retry Refresh.
strings.quota.claude_unavailable: This Claude account did not report subscription limits.
